setting: the Adriatic Sea in the fourteenth century, with a Venetian war fleet blockading a fortified island town
what: the open sea of {setting}, before the town is built or any ship has arrived
build: build the island town and the blockading fleet into it, by night
ground: Paint deep open sea filling the whole frame: dark blue-green water with long even swells and moonlight glittering on it, on a clear night, the same everywhere. In the very middle of the frame lies one large rocky island with low cliffs and a little surf, about half as wide as the frame and half as tall, with nothing built on it yet. There is no other land, and nothing else on the water.
fill: Nothing here is at peace: it is a blockade seen from high above. Keep the scale true: the town is large and each ship is small beside it, no longer than a single quay of the town's little harbour, about one twentieth of the frame's width from stem to stern. The four ships ride at anchor far out near the four corners of the frame, each clearly lit by its lanterns. The open sea between the ships and round the island stays plain, empty water. Add a few tiny rowing boats and barrel buoys close beside the ships only.

camp C.label: galley
camp C.landmark: a Venetian war galley of the blockading fleet riding at anchor, seen small from high above: sails furled, oars shipped, its deck lit by lanterns

commander's camp.label: flagship
commander's camp.landmark: the flagship of the blockading fleet: a Venetian war galley at anchor, seen small from high above, a little larger than the other three, with a gilded stern, more lanterns and a red and gold banner

enemy city.label: island town
enemy city.landmark: the besieged island town, covering the whole of the island: hundreds of small stone and brick houses with tile roofs packed along narrow lanes, towers, a church with a tall bell tower, and a small walled harbour with its chain raised, all inside a sea wall, windows and watch fires lit, shut tight
